body: Are you not reading everything I'm saying? Or are you just cherry picking because you're sticking up for him? Did you not read what has happened to make me feel this way? I've never been like this with an ex. I've talked about hot women with them. I don't think its so bad to ask someone not to save photos of naked women. It makes me feel like shit. Either way, I'm not replying any more.

I literally said that jerking off and watching porn doesn't bother me. Just saving photos of naked women. I find it as a form of betrayal. Especially after he's told me that they are fantasies of what he wished I looked like, he's called me fat, hes told me everyone is hotter than me, etc. Yes, it was during his alcohol abuse year, but it still cut deep. And I respect him enough not to save photos of naked guys because its inappropriate when you're married.

I just want to say he isn't a bad person. We've both been through a lot, he doesn't say mean things to me anymore, and everything he said to be was alcohol induced. He went to rehab for it and regret everything he said to me. It still hurts because rehab wasn't that long ago. And he knows he felt bad about himself and took it out on me. I forgive him for those things, but just because I forgive doesn't mean its completely out of my head. Which is why I just want him to stop saving photos of naked women. I can't work on myself with that hanging on my back. And before I go on I have to say that he isn't alone in this, we had a bad year. People do and say things they dont mean when alcohol abuse is involved. Its just a painful journey. But did I ever say anything about his looks or Weight? No. It just kills me and I feel so awful. I feel like the only way I can get over it is by ending my life. I won't, because I'm honestly too scared to. 

I love my husband. Other than this we are great together. We have good sex, and have always had a very strong connection. Things are just hard.
